annotations.title: Official CBS/IBS/ISS calculator (LC 214/2025, RFB Base V0073)

description: Computes Brazilian consumption-tax reform figures for one amount or a batch of up to 50 lines: it resolves the official Receita Federal cClassTrib classification from a code, NBS, NCM, LC 116 code or sector alias, applies the legal CBS/IBS reduction, the transition rates of the chosen year from 2026 to 2033 and the ISS phase-down, and returns the amounts due, the effective rates, the saving versus full taxation, a calculation trail and the ready-to-embed gIBSCBS XML group. It also simulates Simples Nacional DAS with the annex, revenue bracket and Fator R, and tells you how much CBS/IBS credit the buyer can actually appropriate. Use it for pricing, quoting, contract repricing, credit analysis and any what-if across transition years. Do not use it when you need the printable fiscal document itself, which is what generate_danfse_rtc returns, and do not use it to browse the official tables, which rtc_lookup_official_tables does for free. Deterministic, read-only and fully offline at the edge, so the same input always returns the same figures and a retry is safe. Costs 0.005 USDC per call via x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453) or a B2B X-API-Key; an unpaid call returns HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header. It never throws on bad input: an unparseable body is treated as empty and defaults apply, and an unknown cClassTrib falls back to full taxation with rtc.warning explaining it, so always read classification.matchedBy and rtc.warning before trusting the figure.

aliqCbs.description: Manual override for the nominal CBS rate in percent, bypassing the transition schedule for the chosen year. Use it only to model a scenario; leave it out to apply the official rate. Aliases accepted: cbsAliquota, aliq_cbs.

aliqIbs.description: Manual override for the total nominal IBS rate in percent. It is split between state and municipal shares in the proportion of the chosen transition year. Aliases accepted: ibsAliquota, aliq_ibs.

aliqIbsMun.description: Manual override for the municipal share of the nominal IBS rate, in percent. Overrides the municipal portion of aliqIbs when both are supplied.

aliqIbsUf.description: Manual override for the state (UF) share of the nominal IBS rate, in percent. Overrides the state portion of aliqIbs when both are supplied.

anexoSimples.description: Simples Nacional annex, used only when regime is 'simples_nacional'. When omitted it is derived from atividadeSimples and fatorR, falling back to Annex III. Alias accepted: anexo_simples.

ano.description: Calendar year of the LC 214/2025 transition schedule, defaulting to 2026. Years below 2026 are treated as 2026 (the test year with a 0.9% CBS plus 0.1% IBS token rate) and years above 2033 as 2033 (full CBS/IBS, ISS and ICMS extinguished). The year drives both the nominal rates and the ISS phase-down.

atividadeSimples.description: Official Receita Federal Simples Nacional activity code, '01' to '14' or '90'. Supplying it lets the engine pick the correct annex automatically, including the Annex III versus Annex V switch driven by fatorR.

cClassTrib.description: Official 6-digit Receita Federal cClassTrib code from Base V0073, the highest-priority classifier. Examples: '000001' full taxation, '200003' basic food basket (100% reduction), '200027' property rental (70%), '200028' education (60%), '200029' health (60%), '200044' cybersecurity (60%), '200046' construction (50%), '200047' bars and restaurants (40%), '200052' regulated professions (30%), '620001' fuels (single-phase). An unknown code does not fail the call: full taxation is applied and rtc.warning explains it. Alias accepted: c_class_trib.

discriminacao.description: Short description of the operation, carried into the result and the calculation trail.

fatorR.description: Payroll-to-revenue ratio as a decimal fraction, not a percentage: 0.31 means 31%. At 0.28 or above a service activity falls under Annex III, below it under Annex V. Alias accepted: fator_r.

itens.description: Optional batch of lines priced in a single paid call, capped at 50 items; anything beyond the 50th is ignored. When present, the response adds batchRtcCalculation with per-line figures and the consolidated totals, while rtcCalculation still reflects the top-level valorServico. Each line inherits the top-level regime, ano, rbt12, fatorR and annex, and may override only its own classification and rates.

aliqCbs.description: Line-level manual nominal CBS rate override, in percent.

aliqIbs.description: Line-level manual nominal total IBS rate override, in percent.

cClassTrib.description: Line-level cClassTrib override. Falls back to the top-level cClassTrib when omitted. Alias accepted: c_class_trib.

codigoTributacaoNacional.description: Line-level LC 116 service code, for example '07.02.01', used as a classification fallback.

descricao.description: Line description, echoed back in the result. Defaults to 'Item N'. Alias accepted: description.

nbs.description: Line-level NBS code, used to resolve this line's cClassTrib. Falls back to the top-level nbs.

ncm.description: Line-level NCM code, used to resolve this line's cClassTrib. Falls back to the top-level ncm.

setor.description: Line-level sector alias. Falls back to the top-level setor.

valor.description: Line amount in BRL. Negative values are clamped to zero. Alias accepted: baseCalculo.

nbs.description: NBS service code, 4 to 9 digits. Used to resolve cClassTrib automatically when cClassTrib is absent. Second in resolution priority, after cClassTrib and before ncm.

ncm.description: NCM goods code, 4 to 8 digits. Used to resolve cClassTrib automatically when neither cClassTrib nor nbs is supplied. Third in resolution priority.

rbt12.description: Gross revenue of the last 12 months in BRL, which selects the Simples Nacional revenue bracket and therefore the effective DAS rate. Defaults to 360000.

regime.description: Tax regime, defaulting to 'regime_regular'. 'simples_nacional' adds a DAS simulation and the B2B credit actually transferable to the buyer under LC 214/2025 Art. 41, which is capped at the CBS/IBS share inside the DAS. 'simples_nacional_regular_por_fora' models a Simples company that elected regular CBS/IBS assessment, which transfers full credit to the buyer.

servico.description: The service line itself. Values supplied here take precedence over their top-level equivalents, so prefer this object when issuing a document and use the flat fields only for a quick calculation.

cClassTrib.description: Service-level cClassTrib override, taking precedence over the top-level field.

cbsAliquota.description: Service-level manual nominal CBS rate override, in percent. Alias accepted: aliqCbs.

codigoTributacaoNacional.description: LC 116 national service code, for example '07.02.01'. Used to resolve cClassTrib when no fiscal code or sector is supplied.

descontoIncondicionado.description: Unconditional discount in BRL, subtracted from valorServico to form the CBS/IBS/ISS tax base. Defaults to 0.

discriminacao.description: Full description of the service rendered, printed verbatim on the DANFSe.

ibsAliquota.description: Service-level manual nominal total IBS rate override, in percent. Alias accepted: aliqIbs.

issAliquota.description: Municipal ISS rate in percent, defaulting to 5. It is automatically phased down from 2029 and reaches zero in 2033 under LC 214/2025. Alias accepted: aliqIss.

nbs.description: Service-level NBS code, taking precedence over the top-level field.

ncm.description: Service-level NCM code, taking precedence over the top-level field.

retencaoIss.description: When true, ISS is withheld by the taker and subtracted from valorLiquidoEstimado.

setor.description: Service-level sector alias, taking precedence over the top-level field.

valorServico.description: Gross service amount in BRL, before unconditional discounts.

setor.description: Semantic sector alias, the easiest classifier when the fiscal codes are unknown. Accepted values include 'construcao_civil', 'saude', 'educacao', 'cesta_basica', 'profissao_intelectual', 'locacao_imoveis', 'bares_restaurantes', 'ciberseguranca', 'combustiveis' and 'padrao'. Lowest resolution priority, used only when cClassTrib, nbs, ncm and the LC 116 code all fail to match.

valorServico.description: Amount in BRL to tax, as a plain number (100000 means R$ 100.000,00). Defaults to 1000 when neither this nor servico.valorServico is supplied. Aliases accepted: valor_servico, baseCalculo.

error.description: Stable machine-readable failure code. Common values: 'invalid_payment' / 'settlement_failed' (x402 verification or settlement refused, returned with HTTP 402), 'B2B_KEY_INVALID' and 'B2B_QUOTA_EXCEEDED' (B2B X-API-Key path). A classification that cannot be resolved is NOT an error: the call succeeds with full taxation applied and rtcCalculation.rtc.warning set.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the failure, in Portuguese. Safe to log or surface to a human operator.

meta.description: Provenance of the calculation, worth logging for audit purposes.

legalSource.description: Normative reference and licence of the official tables.

processingTimeMs.description: Edge processing time in milliseconds, excluding payment settlement.

rfbDbVersion.description: Version of the official Receita Federal table set applied, for example 'V0073'.

service.description: Service identifier that produced the result.

zeroJavaServer.description: Always true: the official RTC engine runs entirely at the edge, with no Java service behind it.

ibsAliqEfetivaPct.description: IBS share embedded in the effective DAS rate, in percent.

faixa.description: Revenue bracket index within the annex, 1 to 6.

parcelaDeduzirBrl.description: Deduction amount of the bracket, in BRL, used in the effective-rate formula.

rbt12.description: Trailing 12-month gross revenue in BRL that selected the bracket.

regimeApuracao.description: Assessment mode, 'SN_PLENO' for the single DAS payment.

valorDasEstimadoBrl.description: Estimated DAS due on this operation, in BRL.

valorLiquidoEstimado.description: Estimated net amount to receive in BRL: valorServico less withheld ISS when retencaoIss is true.

status.description: 'CALCULATED' for this tool, since no printable document is produced.

success.description: Present and false only on a rejected call.
